_comment: Canonical cross-app contract for portal invitations and client sessions — see ADR-007 §1/§2. The admin app re-implements the root app's token mechanism rather than importing it (separate deployables), so these values MUST match on both sides: an invitation issued by one app is consumed by the other. Test-time-only fixture, loaded by server/test/client-account-contract.test.js and test/client-account-contract.test.ts. Never imported by production code.
